summary: Hiker returning to the Highway 550 trailhead slipped on gravel on the Bear Creek Trail near the Grizzly Mine, injuring a knee. Nine OMRT rescuers ascended, loaded him in a wheeled litter and rolled him to the highway.
location: Bear Creek Trail near Grizzly Mine
notes: Second Bear Creek Trail knee-injury litter carry in two days.
